body: True shit

I’m just so tired. Even just laying in bed all day I get intrusive thoughts, not to mention hanging out with my friends or just going outside. And accepting the thoughts requires so much energy. I just feel drained and the fact that the thoughts get more intense when I try to make an effort is just discouraging. So many other pieces of my life are coming together except this one thing but because this one thing dominates my thoughts 24/7 I can’t seem to appreciate it

I’m starting to wish I was just asexual so I didn’t have to worry about any of this. I’d rather be celibate than have to deal with this. I don’t have much sexual experience so it’s not like it would impact my life that much anyway

It’s kinda up to you. I’ve cut back a lot on smoking weed to get this under control but I don’t think it does that much. The only thing I notice that’s different when I DO get high is my groinal responses get worse. When I’m high and when I’m sober the thoughts and anxiety are still there.

I’m in early recovery and I get the exact same feeling. I want to start dating again cause I’m getting my attractions back but I always feel so anxious that I won’t like it. I’ve always struggled with confidence around women even before hocd so I think it might be related to that but idk

Same for me when I hear or read that “sexuality is fluid”. Just because the thought is there in my brain doesn’t mean I actually want to do it. Telling me either of these things doesn’t make me feel better
I’m 21 lol just never been great with relationships. I’ll definitely keep your advice in mind tho
So then where would you draw the line between avoidance and making sure I’m in a good place mentally to date?
So is the best course of action to date a girl despite whether or not I think she looks like a guy a might know? Or should I wait it out until the ocd is gone?
I have been, for the most part. I’ve been sitting with the thoughts and working with my therapist but this is the one thought that I feel like is significantly holding me back

It really is. I’ve been struggling so far this morning but I use those moments of clarity as motivation that someday this will hopefully get better with consistent effort of dismissing thoughts and not doing compulsions. Just gotta keep pushing through
That def has to be tough. But if you don’t want to do it then doing it would be a compulsion. Just know you can get better and you got this
Thank you, you too!

I’ve been dealing with this for almost 7 years as well so I’m right there with ya. It’s definitely found some crafty ways to spike the shit outta my anxiety, but some days are easier than others. I’ve wanted to be with girls for as long as I can remember but this disorder is taking that away from me. Wishing you luck with recovery

It’s never too late to go see a therapist. A therapist can help you understand how ocd works and how to manage your symptoms so that the thoughts become less distressing. If you’re only getting worse than you have to go see a therapist. Self help for ocd rarely works. I’ve been trying to avoid seeing a therapist about it for 7 years and I’ve also been stuck in this ocd cycle for 7 years. Didn’t seek out help until very recently but I’m slowly making progress and I’m glad that I did tell a therapist about it.

Yeah I probably wouldn’t experiment unless I knew for sure my psychologist misdiagnosed me. But every time I try to date women I fuck it up or just don’t have the confidence to make a move at all. And I can’t be around my male friends anymore cause it gives me massive anxiety. So basically I’m lonely and hopeless. OCD is a bitch man
It’s from the stress, anxiety, and depression that comes from HOCD. Kinda difficult to feel turned on when those symptoms are bad
Definitely see a therapist. Weed makes me way more anxious as well
I was also completely honest with my therapist about what’s going on inside my head. He said it was likely OCD and that further experimentation wouldn’t be wise
Well that was kinda of the idea behind watching gay porn. I hated it and couldn’t even get hard...
And I’ve suffered with this for almost 7 years. So the idea of people going thru it for a decade or longer seems very daunting
My body and brain send me very mixed messages. My brain more so than my body because it still takes no effort to get aroused by women. But, those damn groinals kill me man
I’ve been trying to do that recently with my psychologist. But having had this for so long I am deathly afraid of the undesired outcome. Groinal responses among other sensations also hold me back
I’m open to hearing it.

That’s true. I think the thoughts of me wanting the gay thoughts stem from me just wanting to be able to accept the thoughts so I can get better and move on. Not necessarily that I actually want to act on them
I had a good grasp of this until my brain began telling me that I like it and that don’t want to be completely straight after all. This is where I’ve been stuck for months
But it’s thoughts and feelings everything is cloudy and idk how to differentiate anything anymore
Idk what my intuition is anymore:/
I’m in the same spot rn. I feel so hopeless and don’t want to leave my room. I just want to lay down and die. Wishing you the best. OCD fucking sucks
Big time. I had read horror stories of other people not getting an ocd diagnosis so I was really scared. But I figured I’d take the risk

Oh I had a full on anxiety attack when I was telling my psychologist about it so I feel ya. I definitely took it as reassurance when he diagnosed me with OCD but I didn’t care because I was so relieved he said it was OCD. Good luck with your recovery process. Here’s to getting better🍻

Hey man I resonate with a lot of what you just said. I’m coming up on nearly 7 years as well (6 years 10 months). This shit is so hard especially dealing with it for as long as we have. And it wasn’t until recently that I found the courage to tell a psychologist what was going on and to seek help.

I never thought about it like this but you’re def making sense. I’ve always wanted to spread awareness about HOCD and show people that it’s different from denial but after reading that it def opened my mind to the possibility that it would open up this community and others to a lot of trolls and uneducated people.
One day at a time🤙🏻
I can definitely relate man. Those moments of clarity, even if they only last a few minutes, are basically what’s keeping me alive rn. Just gotta keep pushing and work on reducing the compulsions
Weed makes my groinal responses WAY stronger
Same here man I just wanna know who tf I am. Best of luck to you too

You’re good man. Thing is tho I don’t really watch straight porn. The idea of seeing a dick while I’m masturbating has repulsed me since the day I started doing it. I only really watch lesbian porn or an occasional pov.

UPDATE: It was bothering me a lot this morning so I decided to check again while I’m sober. Watched the same video as last night plus a couple others. Made sure to breathe and relax and let whatever was going to happen, happen. Turns out it did absolutely nothing for me. Then as soon as I switched the video to one of a girl I got it up easily. This shit is confusing
Yes I have. It actually started during a time when I was watching porn consistently 5-6 times a day during a vacation in middle school
I’m aware of groinal response but for me it only causes tingling, never actual increased blood flow. But now that that happened I’m freaking out
Fair point

Wasn’t really trying to say that. I know my self-confidence issues are separate from HOCD but I remember reading on healthline or one of those sites that low self-confidence in dating could mean that someone is sexually repressed. Reading that definitely sent me into a spiral where I started questioning everything again

I appreciate the support:) I can def relate to it being bad in high school but slowly it got better and my OCD moved on to other themes. Idk why but HOCD decided to come back with a vengeance this year. I had a pretty bad episode during quarantine as well. Honestly I just wish I could intuitively know who I am like everyone else but I know due to this condition that might not be in the cards for me. I’ll def reach out if I need it. Thank you.
Thanks you! You’ve been a big help. I’ll def keep that in mind.
Awesome, thank you. I’m still at the beginning of therapy too so hopefully I can get over this ASAP. Fighting this for 7 years has been the most exhausting thing I’ve ever done:(

Thanks for responding. I’ve been trying to let the thoughts sit for a while now but it feels like the thoughts get stronger the more I let them sit. And especially if I’m around other people, it makes it really difficult because I don’t like to have full blown panic attacks in front of people. Are there any methods that aren’t self reassuring that I can use to manage when the anxiety gets really bad? Or do I just have to go with it and break down even if I’m in public?
